description: List the products endoflife.date tracks in one category: operating systems, databases, programming languages, frameworks, server applications, cloud services, applications, devices or standards. Returns each product slug, name, aliases and tags so you can then look up release dates. Source: endoflife.date; coverage is about 490 products and is not a full software inventory. (cost: 1 credit)

category.description: string, required, one of app, database, device, framework, lang, os, server-app, service, standard

limit.description: integer, optional, products to return, 1-100, default 25

offset.description: integer, optional, skip this many products for paging, default 0

name: eol_products_by_category
